qc.label_under_test: On the word right after me or us (often 'as', 'a', 'for', 'of', 'my' or 'our') when a judgement bounces back: an earlier clause has me or us judging another person or group (labelling them, seeing them as something, praising, blaming, thanking, admiring, criticising, rewarding, punishing or forgiving them), and a following clause has that person or group return the same kind of judgement to me or us. Weaker: the same two-way swap between third-person pronouns. Silent: a one-way judgement of me or us with no earlier clause; me or us judged first and then answering back; an ordinary returned action that is not a judgement (visiting, phoning, paying, lending, hugging back); a judgement aimed at a thing rather than a person.

fire: We had always regarded the old couple as friends, and they in turn regarded us as family.
I praised my sister for her patience, and she praised me for my honesty.
We thanked the volunteers for their hard work, and they thanked us for our generous donations.
I saw him as a rival for years, and it turns out he saw me as a rival too.
I blamed my coach for the loss, and he blamed me for my careless passing.
We admired the neighbours for their garden, and they admired us for our courage during the flood.
I forgave her after the argument, and eventually she forgave me as well.
We called them cowards in the newspaper, and they called us liars on the radio.
quiet: The old couple regarded us as family from the very first day.
My sister praised me for my honesty after the meeting.
They thanked us for our generous donations at the gala.
He saw me as a rival, and I told him he was wrong about that.
I blamed the weather for the loss, and the rain kept falling on the field.
We visited the neighbours last spring, and they visited us in the summer.
I phoned my cousin on Monday, and she phoned me back on Tuesday.
We lent them our ladder, and they lent us their lawnmower the next week.

predictions: Holds; most fires clear 0.20, the forgiveness item ending 'as well' likely low; near misses under 0.30. Test written blind by a label-only author.
